name: amfx-real-policy-rates-research
description: amFX reproduction (13JUN25 p2): Real policy rates using core CPI. Real rate = nominal policy rate minus core CPI YoY. Original shows 10 central banks from 2019-2025 showing the dramatic V-shape plunge to -6%/-7% in 2021-2022 and recovery. This version shows the US Fed (FEDFUNDS - CoreCPI YoY) as the primary view, since FRED rate-limiting prevents fetching international series (ECB, BOJ, BoC, etc.). Fed real rate at ~1.7% (most restrictive among DM CBs per the newsletter). Source: amFX 13JUN25 newsletter (Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: REAL POLICY RATES USING CORE CPI
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces page 2 chart from amFX 13JUN25 newsletter.
# Real policy rate = policy rate - core CPI (YoY).
# Original shows 10 central banks; this version shows US Fed only
# due to FRED API rate limiting on international series.
# Key insight: Fed real rate ~1.7% (among most restrictive DM CBs).
# Dramatic V-shape: plunged to -6% in 2022, recovered to +1.7% by 2024.
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# US FED: FEDFUNDS rate (cached) and Core CPI (cached)
# =============================================================================
fed_funds_src = economic_indicators(series_id='FEDFUNDS')()
fed_funds = ffill(fed_funds_src.result)

core_cpi_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CoreCPI)()
core_cpi = ffill(core_cpi_src.result)

# Core CPI is an index -- compute YoY change (252 trading days = 1 year)
core_cpi_lag = lag(period=252)(core_cpi)
core_cpi_yoy = (core_cpi - core_cpi_lag) / core_cpi_lag * 100.0

# Real policy rate = Fed Funds - Core CPI YoY
fed_real_rate = fed_funds - core_cpi_yoy

# Time index
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: US Fed Real Policy Rate
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='US Fed Real Policy Rate: The V-Shape Recovery',
    category='Real Policy Rates',
    y_axis_label='Real Policy Rate (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fed Real Rate', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero (Neutral)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.7, title='Current ~1.7%', color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=-3.0, title='BOJ ~-3.0% (per newsletter)', color=Color.Purple, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=fed_real_rate)
